hasMenuItem.name: Tagliere del Cacciatore
hasMenuItem.description: A selection of cured Cinta Senese pork and game meats, bringing the most authentic flavours of the local area to your table.

hasMenuItem.name: Tartare dell’Oste
hasMenuItem.description: Beef tartare, hand-cut with a knife and prepared to order to bring out the quality of the meat and its authentic flavour. Served on a crispy Parmesan wafer and accompanied by antique wholegrain mustard.

hasMenuItem.name: Tagliere del Contadino
hasMenuItem.description: Tuscan pecorino cheeses paired with honey and preserves that bring all the goodness of the region straight to your table.

hasMenuItem.name: Bis di crostoni
hasMenuItem.description: Two toasted bread slices with very different flavours: one topped with Gorgonzola and slices of truffle, the other with Tuscan cheese, pears and honey. Two combinations that bring together bold flavours, creaminess and delicate sweet notes.

hasMenuItem.name: Acciughe sotto pesto
hasMenuItem.description: Anchovies with Senese tarragon pesto: fragrant, full of flavour and with that unexpected little something extra.

hasMenuItem.name: Crostini neri senesi
hasMenuItem.description: A true symbol of Senese cuisine, with an unmistakable classic flavour that brings the tastes of Siena straight to your table.

hasMenuItem.name: Tagliatelle ai Funghi Porcini
hasMenuItem.description: Tagliatelle with porcini mushrooms: the scent of the Tuscan woods in an autumn dish.

hasMenuItem.name: Tagliatelle al Tartufo di Stagione
hasMenuItem.description: Tagliatelle served with the intense aroma of sliced, seasonal fresh truffle.

hasMenuItem.name: Pici al Ragù Tradizionale di Anatra
hasMenuItem.description: Traditional pici tossed in a rich, flavourful duck ragù. A rustic dish, the kind that tastes of home and proper Tuscan cooking.

hasMenuItem.name: Pici al Ragù Bianco di Cinta Senese
hasMenuItem.description: White Cinta Senese pork ragù, made without tomato and seasoned with our house’s secret blend of herbs and spices.

hasMenuItem.name: Tagliatelle al Ragù di Cinghiale
hasMenuItem.description: Tagliatelle served with wild boar ragù, full of the authentic, rustic flavours of Tuscan tradition.

hasMenuItem.name: Pici Cacio e Pepe
hasMenuItem.description: Pici with Tuscan pecorino cheese and black pepper, our Tuscan take on a great Italian classic.

hasMenuItem.name: Spaghetti alla Chitarra con Sugo dell’Osteria
hasMenuItem.description: A historic recipe from Osteria dei Rossi, on the menu since 1992: a tomato-based sauce with Gorgonzola and chilli, bringing together bold, unmistakable flavours.

hasMenuItem.name: Ravioli con Zucca Gialla, Pancetta e stracciatella
Ribollita
hasMenuItem.description: The famous Tuscan peasant soup, steeped in history. Sometimes the simplest things are the best.

hasMenuItem.name: Cinghiale in Dolce Forte
hasMenuItem.description: An ancient Tuscan medieval recipe, where the intense flavour of wild boar meets the distinctive sweet-and-sour balance of dolce forte.

hasMenuItem.name: Tegamata di Cinta Senese
hasMenuItem.description: A slow-cooked Cinta Senese pork stew, made without a tomato base, using meat from free-range pigs raised in the heart of the Crete Senesi.

hasMenuItem.name: Agnello allo Scottadito
hasMenuItem.description: Grilled lamb chops, best enjoyed piping hot, just as tradition dictates.

hasMenuItem.name: Cinghiale al Coccio con Polenta
hasMenuItem.description: Slow-cooked, aromatic wild boar stew served with polenta: a true classic of Tuscan cooking.

hasMenuItem.name: Sovracosce di Pollo alla Diavola
hasMenuItem.description: Crispy grilled chicken thighs served with our homemade spicy sauce.

hasMenuItem.name: Trippa alla Senese
hasMenuItem.description: A dish rooted in traditional Senese home cooking, especially associated with Palio season. Served in a tomato sauce with sausage and chilli.

hasMenuItem.name: Bistecca alla Fiorentina
hasMenuItem.description: The house speciality: a weekly selection hand-picked by Alessio, our trusted butcher.

hasMenuItem.name: Bistecca Fritta
hasMenuItem.description: Our unconventional take on the queen of the Tuscan table: a proper Florentine steak, breaded and fried until crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside. You have to try it at least once!

hasMenuItem.name: Costata del macellaio
hasMenuItem.description: A cut of beef similar to a Florentine steak, but without the tenderloin, perfect for those who love the authentic taste of grilled meat.

hasMenuItem.name: Medaglione di Filetto alla Griglia
hasMenuItem.description: A beef fillet medallion cooked on the grill, to enjoy just as it is or with one of our toppings.

hasMenuItem.name: Medaglione di Filetto alla Griglia, con Tartufo
hasMenuItem.description: For those who simply can’t say no to truffle.

hasMenuItem.name: Medaglione di Filetto alla Griglia, con Lardo di Colonnata
hasMenuItem.description: Delicate, flavourful cured pork fat from Colonnata, bringing a rich and satisfying pairing to the fillet.

hasMenuItem.name: Medaglione di Filetto alla Griglia, con salsa al Pepe Verde
hasMenuItem.description: Delicate green peppercorn sauce, finished with brandy

hasMenuItem.name: Fagioli all’Uccelletto
hasMenuItem.description: A Tuscan favourite: flavourful beans, perfect alongside our house dishes.

hasMenuItem.name: Chips di Patate Croccanti
hasMenuItem.description: Golden, crispy and impossible to stop eating. Do we really need to say more?

hasMenuItem.name: Patate Prezzemolate
hasMenuItem.description: Boiled potatoes dressed with chopped parsley, oil, salt and pepper. Simple, honest and always right at home on the plate.

hasMenuItem.name: Erbe Saltate
hasMenuItem.description: Swiss chard, chicory and spinach sautéed with garlic, olive oil and chilli. Greens with a bit of attitude.

hasMenuItem.name: Insalata Mista
hasMenuItem.description: Fresh mixed salad with seasonal vegetables, for something light and wholesome.

hasMenuItem.name: Il Tiramisù di Manu
hasMenuItem.description: Manu’s tiramisù.

hasMenuItem.name: Cantuccini e Vin Santo
hasMenuItem.description: Tuscan almond biscuits with Vin Santo dessert wine.

hasMenuItem.name: Tortino al Cioccolato con Cuore Caldo
hasMenuItem.description: Chocolate fondant with a warm, melting centre.

hasMenuItem.name: Tris di Dolci Senesi
hasMenuItem.description: A trio of traditional Sienese sweets.

hasMenuItem.name: Carpaccio di Pere e Scaglie di Cioccolato Fondente
hasMenuItem.description: Thinly sliced pears with dark chocolate shavings.
